# Vendored libraries

## cobe.esm.js

- Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/cobe
- Version: 2.0.1
- License: MIT (see COBE-LICENSE.txt)
- Unmodified build output (`dist/index.esm.js`) from the published npm package.
  Self-hosted per the build brief's hard constraint (no CDN/runtime npm dependency).
- Default export: `createGlobe(canvas, options) => { update(state), destroy() }`.
